justification: Changes how future Hornsby residential rows are zoned and adds two switches to a database tool; this merge writes nothing, the write is a separate approved run.

pre_impl.existing_data: 685 live Hornsby Part 3 rows tagged zones R2,R3,R4 from the Part introduction; 16 of them narrower already
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A row with no pdf_page, or outside every section range, keeps the Part's zones, so nothing is narrowed by guess
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New publishes pick up section zones through the tagger; existing rows change only when the tool is run with --apply

functions.name: _get_config_driven
functions.input: the document id, row text, part and pdf page
functions.output: the config entry result with section keys applied when the page is in a range
functions.if_none: no pdf page or no page_sections leaves the chapter entry exactly as before

functions.name: only_narrowing
functions.input: the re-tag plan rows with old and new zones and types
functions.output: only rows that remove zones or types and add none
functions.if_none: an empty plan returns an empty list and nothing is written

functions.name: build_plan
functions.input: a database cursor, council list and optional chapter key
functions.output: the change plan limited to that chapter when one is given
functions.if_none: no chapter keeps the previous whole-council behaviour

queries.where_clause: source_council in the list and, when given, source_chapter_key equals the chapter
queries.if_zero: the plan is empty and nothing changes
queries.if_wrong: rows of another chapter would be re-tagged

break_it.scenario: A run meant to narrow widens rows another step had narrowed
break_it.what_happens: R2 lots start seeing apartment rules again
break_it.how: only_narrowing and its test; the dry run left the four 3.5.1 rows untouched

break_it.scenario: A section boundary page is off by one
break_it.what_happens: House rules are hidden from R2 lots
break_it.how: boundary pages tested; every narrowed served row's own section number was 3.2, 3.3, 3.4 or none, never 3.1

break_it.scenario: A re-read plan moves the pages
break_it.what_happens: Page ranges would zone rows from the wrong section
break_it.how: residual: ranges are fixed to the 23 June 2025 amendment; a new plan version needs the ranges re-read
break_it.repro: compare section start pages in the new PDF

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a page in sections 3.2 to 3.4 resolves to other zones, 3.1 or 3.5 pages are narrowed, or narrow-only keeps a widening row
falsifiable_check.observed_red: A dry run without narrow-only planned to widen 4 served rows on pages 83-84 from R4 to R2,R3,R4; with only_narrowing those rows are left out

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: the re-tag write needs owner approval, then rules_per_address must show only these rows removed at 028 and 029
